name: Biomedical Sciences PhD Programs
detailsNote: Admissions page confirms 2027–28 dates; overview still displays December 1,2025. Current admissions page controls.
summary: Common Biomedical Sciences admission followed by three first-semester rotations and selection of a dissertation program.

english.toefl: 79 legacy iBT; new-scale requirement not established
english.note: Program also lists TOEFL Essentials 9 and PTE Academic 53. Official scores for review. Citizenship or bachelor’s from listed countries exempts (including India, Nepal, Pakistan); no general MOI-letter exemption inferred.

applicationFee.note: Fee 75 USD and category waivers reused from official text checked 2026-10-24; live central page 403 on Oct 29. Categories: current WVU/WVU Medicine employees, US military/veterans, AmeriCorps/Peace Corps; no general hardship offer. International applicants must confirm applicable category.

documents: Personal statement: scientific interests, research question/role/results/duration, program motivation, career goals, achievements/service and resume gaps
Three signed letters on university/company letterhead from professors/supervisors
Unofficial transcripts all institutions; official records/degree proof and English translations upon admission
requirements.note: Upper-level science/math/engineering recommended; competitive STEM GPA 3.5 and strong research record. Master’s unnecessary. Three first-semester lab rotations then dissertation mentor/program. WES evaluation optional; university evaluates records. Current admissions says virtual interviews December–March, overriding older phone/in-person FAQ.

funding.note: Full support with good standing, research excellence/progress: undated minimum stipend 30,000 USD, tuition and health insurance. Student fees approximately 650 USD fall/spring and 250 summer not covered. International students supported unless home-country scholarship; additional financial proof may be needed for visa shortfall.
